author: mu-wit
body: [watermelon-full-preview] Kokoro-82M measurements on this devserver (4 threads, host load ~60): model load 1.02s; per-sentence wall 0.50-1.14s for 45-82 chars; audio 2.4-7.4s per sentence; real-time factor 4.2-6.5x; 54 voices in voices-v1.0.bin. Files: kokoro-v1.0.onnx 325MB + voices-v1.0.bin 28MB fetched once into a model dir outside the repo. Licences: Kokoro-82M model card apache-2.0 (weights and voices); Piper code MIT, Piper voices per-dataset (sidecar header says to read each voice's .onnx.json). Real sidecar verified by hand: GET /voices lists 54, POST /synthesize returns non-silent WAV (peak 15279, 56832 samples).
